title.narrative: Youth for Sustainable Change – Gender Inequality in the Philippines

description.narrative: During the recent project visit, which was specifically geared towards partnership development, a multitude of potential areas of work were identified within the expansive scope of the project. The preparatory study is poised to delve deeply into understanding the varying and unique local challenges faced by young women in their respective communities. The visit is designed to kickstart community dialogues that engage young women in meaningful conversations surrounding a spectrum of gender-related issues. These issues include but are not limited to teenage pregnancy, sexual and reproductive rights, the active participation of young women in politics, and the problem of gender-based violence. The overarching goal of this preparatory study is to gather knowledge and examine the possibilities for starting a pilot project with the target to actively involve and empower more young women in addressing these pressing gender-related challenges. In doing so, the project aims to contribute significantly to the realization of one of Akbayan Youth's primary objectives - to organize and mobilize young people across all sub-sectors, with an emphasis on organizing more young women in Akbayan Youth.
